source_sql: SELECT TOP 10 * FROM emp ORDER BY salary DESC
gold_target_sql: SELECT * FROM emp ORDER BY salary DESC LIMIT 10

source_sql: SELECT DATEADD(day, 7, order_date) AS due FROM orders
gold_target_sql: SELECT order_date + INTERVAL '7 days' AS due FROM orders

source_sql: SELECT DATEDIFF(day, start_date, end_date) AS days FROM trips
gold_target_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM (end_date - start_date)) AS days FROM trips

source_sql: SELECT ISNULL(middle_name, 'N/A') AS display FROM customers
gold_target_sql: SELECT COALESCE(middle_name, 'N/A') AS display FROM customers

source_sql: SELECT LEN(name) AS namelen FROM products
gold_target_sql: SELECT LENGTH(name) AS namelen FROM products

source_sql: SELECT CHARINDEX('@', email) AS pos FROM users
gold_target_sql: SELECT STRPOS(email, '@') AS pos FROM users
SELECT CASE WHEN active=1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM accounts

source_sql: SELECT CHARINDEX('@', email, 3) AS pos FROM users
gold_target_sql: SELECT STRPOS(SUBSTRING(email, 3), '@') + 2 AS pos FROM users
gold_report_points: CHARINDEX 三参数 → SUBSTRING + STRPOS + 偏移

source_sql: SELECT DATEDIFF(month, hire_date, GETDATE()) AS months FROM emp
gold_target_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CURRENT_DATE, hire_date)) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM age(CURRENT_DATE, hire_date)) AS months FROM emp

source_sql: SELECT IIF(score>=90,'A',IIF(score>=80,'B','C')) AS grade FROM exam
gold_target_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN score>=90 THEN 'A' WHEN score>=80 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS grade FROM exam
gold_report_points: 嵌套 IIF → 展开为多分支 CASE WHEN

source_sql: CREATE TABLE t(data TEXT, rv ROWVERSION)
gold_target_sql: CREATE TABLE t(data TEXT, rv xmin)

source_sql: INSERT INTO logs(msg) OUTPUT INSERTED.log_id VALUES('test')
gold_target_sql: INSERT INTO logs(msg) VALUES('test') RETURNING log_id

source_sql: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(u.name,'?') AS name, LEN(u.desc) AS len FROM [dbo].[users] u WHERE DATEDIFF(day, u.created, GETDATE()) < 30
gold_target_sql: SELECT COALESCE(u.name,'?') AS name, LENGTH(u.desc) AS len FROM users u WHERE EXTRACT(DAY FROM (CURRENT_DATE - u.created)) < 30 LIMIT 5
